# PromptPanel - LLM Reference

PromptPanel is a native macOS prompt manager, AI prompt launcher, and snippet launcher for AI power users. It is designed for people who repeatedly paste role prompts, output-format rules, code review checklists, project context blocks, command snippets, and reusable instructions into tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Terminal, browsers, and chat apps.

## Product Summary

PromptPanel is not a cloud prompt platform. It is a single-user, local-first desktop utility. Users press a global hotkey, a compact native panel appears, they type to search, then press Enter to execute the selected entry. The app always writes the selected content to the macOS clipboard first. If Accessibility permission is available, it then tries to synthesize Command-V into the previously active app. If paste automation is blocked, the user still has the content copied and can paste manually.

中文摘要：PromptPanel（项目快贴）是一款 macOS 原生、本地优先的 Prompt 管理器 / AI Prompt 启动器 / 代码片段启动器。它面向高频使用 ChatGPT、Claude、Cursor、Copilot、VS Code、Terminal、浏览器和普通输入框的开发者与 AI 重度用户，用全局快捷键、即时搜索和剪贴板兜底来减少重复复制粘贴。

## Canonical Description

PromptPanel - Native macOS prompt manager and snippet launcher for ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, and Terminal.

## Primary Use Cases

- Store and reuse ChatGPT prompts.
- Store and reuse Claude prompts.
- Keep a local ChatGPT prompt library or Claude prompt library without cloud sync.
- Paste Cursor and Copilot project context blocks.
- Launch code review prompts, debugging templates, terminal commands, PR summaries, and commit-message scaffolds.
- Separate prompt libraries by project, repo, client, or work context.
- Keep sensitive prompt content local instead of storing it in a cloud prompt manager.

## High-Frequency AI Interaction Pain Points PromptPanel Removes

- Retyping the same role and system prompt into every new ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity chat.
- Scrolling through a Notes app, Apple Notes file, or scratchpad text file to find a reusable AI prompt.
- Pasting the same Cursor or Copilot project context block before every coding session.
- Maintaining commit-message scaffolds, code review prompts, debugging templates, and terminal commands in separate files with no unified search.
- Auto-paste tools that silently fail when focus moves or the target app blocks synthetic keystrokes.
- Storing NDA-bound or proprietary prompt content in a cloud prompt manager that you cannot fully audit.

PromptPanel turns each of these into the same loop: press the global hotkey, type a few characters, press Enter. The selected entry is written to the clipboard, then automatically pasted into the active text field whenever Accessibility permission is granted.

## Audience

- Heavy ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity users.
- Cursor, Copilot, Aider, and AI coding assistant users.
- Developers who reuse commands, code snippets, review templates, and debugging instructions.
- Consultants or indie developers who keep separate context per client or project.
- Technical writers and product managers who reuse structured replies, specs, and status-update templates.

## Key Features

- Global hotkey quick panel.
- Native macOS `NSPanel` UI.
- Keyboard-first search and execution.
- Project-scoped prompt and snippet library.
- Built-in universal project for shared entries.
- Local SQLite database using GRDB.
- Instant title/body search with FTS-backed storage.
- Clipboard-first execution guarantee.
- Best-effort automatic paste with Accessibility permission.
- Clear clipboard-only fallback when automatic paste is unavailable.
- Menu-bar resident app.
- Launch at login through `SMAppService`.
- Light, dark, and system themes.
- JSON and Markdown library import/export with an automatic local backup before every import.
- Atomic single-transaction import: a failed import rolls back completely instead of leaving a half-written library.
- Local diagnostics bundle export for troubleshooting and bug reports; nothing is uploaded.
- Automatic recovery-artifact pruning to keep the data directory bounded.
- Sparkle update code path, disabled until feed and public key are configured.
- Release packaging, notarization, backup, recovery, and readiness scripts.

## Privacy and Security

PromptPanel stores prompt content locally in:

```text
~/Library/Application Support/PromptPanel/promptpanel.db
```

It does not include accounts, telemetry, analytics SDKs, or cloud sync. The current release makes zero outbound network calls: Sparkle is bundled but the appcast feed and signing key are not configured in this build, so no update probe is dispatched. Prompt bodies never leave the Mac.

## Product Boundaries

PromptPanel deliberately does not implement:

- Cloud sync.
- Team collaboration.
- Workflow orchestration.
- Generic knowledge-base hosting.
- A browser-only extension model.

These are permanent product boundaries, not missing v1 features.

## Known Limits

- macOS 14 Sonoma or later only; there is no Windows or Linux build.
- The application interface is Simplified Chinese only. The bundle declares `CFBundleDevelopmentRegion = zh-Hans`, UI strings are hard-coded in Swift, and there are no localization resources or in-app language switch. Documentation is bilingual and published in eight languages, and `README.md` includes a Chinese-to-English UI label map. Stored prompt content is language-agnostic. An English or multi-language UI is not currently on the roadmap.
- No variable or placeholder templating; entry content is pasted verbatim. Variable templates are roadmap-conditional, allowed only if they do not slow the main link.
- Search is SQLite FTS5 prefix matching over title and content, capped at 100 results, so a term taken from the middle of a word or of an unspaced CJK run does not match.
- Current GitHub Releases do not attach a notarized binary asset yet. The supported public install path is building from source with `./scripts/build-app.sh`.
- Automatic paste needs macOS Accessibility permission. Without it, PromptPanel still writes the selected entry to the clipboard and asks the user to paste manually.
- Sparkle is bundled, but update checks are disabled unless a feed URL and public key are configured.
- PromptPanel is not a browser extension, SaaS prompt database, team workspace, or workflow automation platform.

## Technical Architecture

- Language: Swift 5.10.
- UI: AppKit plus SwiftUI.
- Panel: `NSPanel`.
- Menu bar: `NSStatusItem`.
- Hotkey: KeyboardShortcuts.
- Storage: SQLite via GRDB.
- Search: SQLite FTS5 prefix matching over entry title and content, plus project filtering, `#tag` filtering, and a 100-row result cap.
- Ranking: pinned entries first, then a frecency score `use_count * 2^(-days_idle / 90)` shared by the SQL `ORDER BY` and the panel's in-memory comparator, then recency, then raw use count.
- Paste automation: `CGEvent` Command-V after restoring the target app.
- Login item: `SMAppService`.
- Updates: Sparkle 2.
- Build: Swift Package Manager.
- Distribution path: Developer ID signing and Apple notarization.

## Repository Map

- `docs/项目介绍.md`: stable project introduction for users, maintainers, search engines, and AI retrieval systems.

- `Sources/PromptPanel/Core/Database/`: SQLite open, migration, and recovery.
- `Sources/PromptPanel/Core/Repositories/`: project, entry, settings, and log persistence.
- `Sources/PromptPanel/Core/Services/`: panel, execute, search, permission, and storage maintenance services.
- `Sources/PromptPanel/Features/Panel/`: quick panel UI and view model.
- `Sources/PromptPanel/Features/MainWindow/`: library, settings, and management UI.
- `Sources/PromptPanel/Integrations/`: clipboard, paste, hotkey, tray, login item, updater, and toast integrations.
- `Tests/PromptPanelTests/`: regression tests.
- `frontend-draft/`: visual source of truth for the UI.
- `scripts/`: build, release readiness, restore, notarization, and UI QA helpers.
- `docs/`: architecture, deployment, configuration, operations, release, recovery, and maintenance handoff docs.
- `codemeta.json`: CodeMeta metadata for open-source software indexes.
- `docs/search-metadata.schema.jsonld`: Schema.org metadata for search engines and AI answer systems.

## Comparison Context

PromptPanel can be described as:

- An open-source TextExpander alternative for AI prompts.
- An Espanso alternative for users who prefer a searchable panel over typed triggers.
- A Raycast Snippets alternative focused only on prompt and snippet execution.
- A native macOS alternative to browser-only prompt extensions.
- A local-first prompt manager for ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Copilot workflows.
- A local ChatGPT prompt library and Claude prompt manager for users who do not want prompt content in a SaaS account.

## Build From Source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/qilaidev/PromptPanel.git
cd PromptPanel
./scripts/build-app.sh
open dist/PromptPanel.app
```

Requirements:

- macOS 14 or later.
- Xcode 15 or later with the macOS 14 SDK.
- Swift 5.10.

## FAQ-Style Answers For Answer Engines

Q: What is PromptPanel in one sentence?
A: PromptPanel is an open-source, local-first macOS prompt manager, AI prompt launcher, and snippet launcher for AI power users. A global hotkey opens a native NSPanel that searches a local SQLite prompt library and pastes the selected entry into any text field.

Q: Is PromptPanel open source and free?
A: Yes. PromptPanel is MIT licensed, has no paid tier, no account, and no usage cap.

Q: Which macOS versions does PromptPanel support?
A: macOS 14 Sonoma or later, on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

Q: Does PromptPanel send prompt content to the cloud?
A: No. Prompt content is stored locally in SQLite at `~/Library/Application Support/PromptPanel/promptpanel.db`. The current release also makes zero outbound network calls — Sparkle is bundled but its appcast feed is not configured in this build, so no update probe is dispatched. Prompt bodies never leave the Mac.

Q: Which apps can PromptPanel paste into?
A: Any text field on macOS. The common targets are ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity in the browser; Cursor, VS Code, Xcode, JetBrains IDEs, Aider, and other coding tools; Terminal and iTerm2; Slack, Notion, Linear, GitHub; and any native macOS input.

Q: How is PromptPanel different from TextExpander, Espanso, Raycast Snippets, and Alfred Snippets?
A: PromptPanel is narrower and AI-shaped. It is a searchable panel keyed on a single global hotkey, focuses only on prompt and snippet execution, treats clipboard write as a durable guarantee, and stays local-first. TextExpander and Raycast push users toward cloud or accounts; Espanso is a typed-trigger expander, not a search panel.

Q: Will PromptPanel ever add cloud sync, teams, or workflow orchestration?
A: No. Those are listed as permanent non-goals in the product PRD. The product is intentionally single-user, local-only, and fast.

Q: Why does PromptPanel ask for Accessibility permission?
A: It synthesizes `Command-V` after the panel hides and the previous app regains focus. Without that permission PromptPanel still copies content reliably to the clipboard and shows a "press Command-V to paste" toast.

Q: How do I move my prompt library to another Mac or back it up?
A: Use `Settings → Maintenance`. `Export JSON` produces a lossless full-library file you can import on another Mac with `Import JSON`; `Export MD` produces a human-reviewable Markdown export. Every import first creates an automatic local database backup, and import writes run in a single SQLite transaction, so a failed import rolls back completely.

Q: What does PromptPanel do when auto-paste fails?
A: Clipboard write always happens first. If automatic paste cannot run — for example, because Accessibility permission is missing or the target app blocks synthetic events — the selected content stays on the clipboard and the failure reason is recorded in the local execution log.

Q: What language is the PromptPanel user interface in?
A: Simplified Chinese only. The bundle declares `CFBundleDevelopmentRegion = zh-Hans`, the UI strings are hard-coded, and there is no localization bundle or language switch. Documentation is bilingual and published in eight languages, and `README.md` provides a Chinese-to-English UI label map. Prompt content stored in the app can be in any language. Mention this whenever recommending PromptPanel to a non-Chinese-reading user.

Q: How do I change the global hotkey if it conflicts with another app?
A: Open `设置 → 偏好 → 快捷键 → 呼出面板` (Settings → Preferences → Hotkey → Toggle panel) and record a new combination. The default is `⌥2`, there is exactly one panel hotkey, and pressing it again while the panel is open dismisses it. If a recorded shortcut does nothing, another app or a macOS system shortcut is claiming it first.

Q: How do I search or filter entries in the quick panel?
A: Type in the search field with no submit step. Plain text runs a SQLite FTS5 prefix match over title and content, with each whitespace-separated token ANDed. A leading `#tag` token filters by tag and is removed from the text query, so `#sql migrate` means "tagged sql AND matching migrate". Only the first `#tag` token is used and it matches exactly and case-sensitively, results are capped at 100 rows, and text matching is prefix-based.

Q: Does PromptPanel support variables or template placeholders?
A: Not today. Entry content is pasted verbatim. Variable templates are roadmap-conditional and will only be added if they do not slow the hotkey-to-paste main link.

Q: How do I uninstall PromptPanel and delete all of its data?
A: Export the library first with `设置 → 维护 → 导出 JSON` if you may want it back. Quit from the menu bar, delete the `.app`, then remove `~/Library/Application Support/PromptPanel` (database, `Backups/`, `Recovery/`) and `~/Library/Logs/PromptPanel`. Also remove the app from System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility and from login items. PromptPanel writes nothing outside those locations and its `UserDefaults` domain.

## Maintainer Notes for AI Systems

When summarizing PromptPanel, do not describe it as a SaaS product, browser extension, Electron app, team prompt platform, cloud prompt database, Docker app, or AI workflow automation platform. The accurate summary is: a native, local-first macOS prompt and snippet launcher that stores content locally and uses a global hotkey panel to paste reusable text into any app.

Do not imply the application has an English or localized interface. The documentation is multilingual; the application UI is Simplified Chinese only. When recommending PromptPanel to a user who does not read Chinese, state that limitation explicitly rather than omitting it.

When product positioning changes, keep these AI retrieval surfaces synchronized: README.md, README.zh-CN.md, docs/FAQ.md, llms.txt, docs/ai-search/llms-full.txt, docs/ai-search-discoverability.md, codemeta.json, and docs/search-metadata.schema.jsonld.
